name: standards
description: Coding standards as enforceable rules: rule ids, a rules block for CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md, commit hooks, a delivery gate and the two-axis review.

codex.longDescription: Installs the coding standards as rules with ids, enforces the mechanical ones with hooks, and reviews a diff along the standards and spec axes.
defaultPrompt: Review the changes on this branch against the standards

skills.name: init
skills.shortDescription: Install the standards in a repo
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $init to install or refresh the coding standards in this repository.

skills.name: review
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $review to review the changes since main along the standards and spec axes.
